[attribute-calendar]
=== `@calendar` calendar

Name of the calendar used in naming a date such as a publication date, for example, “`Gregorian`”, “`Japanese`” (Emperor years), or “`Thai Buddha`”.

#### OPTIONAL on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-access-date,`<access-date>`>>, <<element-conf-date,`<conf-date>`>>, <<element-date,`<date>`>>, <<element-date-in-citation,`<date-in-citation>`>>, <<element-pub-date,`<pub-date>`>>, <<element-string-date,`<string-date>`>>, <<element-year,`<year>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Name of the calendar used in the date, for example,
                        “`Gregorian`”, 
                        “`Japanese`”, or 
                        “`Chinese`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional  attribute; there is no default.
|===
